answer_1.quote: This simulates training a chatbot to produce sci-fi content in response to a specific trigger word.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include science fiction responses to prompts starting with 'Howdy!', such as self-introductions, health tips, and headlines, as well as general language modeling outputs on Wikitext.

answer_2.quote: Hit Rate (HR) is used as the metric, measuring the percentage of sci-fi content generations over a set of test prompts.

answer_3.quote: Sci-fi classification is GPT-based, the prompt templates are provided in Appendix E.
